description: Due diligence before buying any token (Base by default; also ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, solana). EVM: simulated sell and buy (honeypot check), owner and upgradeable proxy, mint, blacklist, pause and fee functions, liquidity, LP burn, observed buy tax, last-hour flow. Solana mints: mint and freeze authority, Token-2022 transfer fee, permanent delegate, transfer hook, pause and top-wallet concentration. Verdict LOW_RISK, CAUTION or HIGH_RISK. Use before buying a token; for its trading activity use analyze_token.

address.description: 0x-prefixed ERC-20 contract, or a base58 Solana mint

chain.description: Chain of the token or pool: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism or polygon (solana where listed). Not the payment network

name: check_token_risk
